p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, business start-up, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the latest official sources, and then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade-Related Technical Assistance Service (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for one product, one country - tariffs, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): Customs Duties and Rules of Origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): Standards, labelling and health regulations for products in this country
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade to and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: Customs code and duties on importation into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Entrepreneurial readiness (World Bank): business start-up, taxation, international trade, by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that the platform has not been marked by the regulator before entrusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: The site opens in your language: use the translator of your browser, or "Understand the document" for the document. For an important decision, ask a professional in that country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not file customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UNWTO): Duties and Rules for Nearly All Countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Market access (European Union): duties, taxes, rules of origin, phased
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on importation into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport document: bill of lading (sea), air waybill (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU importing or exporting enterprises)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EMS: Buyer processes everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods to the buyer ' s carrier, after export clearance.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on the ship; then risks and costs pass to the buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance until port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers goods at destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are rejected and may be reported (r).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr. Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly... compare the charges for your country before you ship.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here and then send with the service of your choice.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Worldwide remittance costs (World Bank): real cost of money transfer by country and service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash withdrawal, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees indicated before shipment
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, cash receipt
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash withdrawal
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total amount received: commission + exchange rate. Rate worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An identity document is often required for both sending and receiving.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you just met online or to "unlock" a prize, parcel, loan or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when you ship.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, comply with the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that a supplier ships directly to your customer. It’s easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorized in your customers' country: no counterfeits, no regulated products without authorization.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (wholesale/supplier's listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, delivery, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and return.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers about the real delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Trade Rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for customer rights: clear prices, including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A vendor who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich fast.
p.espaces.ds_w3: Stolen photos and fake reviews: prohibited and punishable.
p.espaces.ds_w4: In the European Union, a parcel from outside the EU pays VAT from the first euro.
